description: This file contains a mock implementation of the IClusterMembershipService interface for unit testing purposes. It manages a set of silo statuses and snapshots, providing mechanisms to update and retrieve cluster membership information.

classes.name: MockClusterMembershipService
classes.description: A mock implementation of IClusterMembershipService for testing, simulating silo membership updates and snapshots.

methods.name: UpdateSiloStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and name of a specific silo, then publishes a new cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: ToSnapshot
methods.description: Converts current statuses and version into an immutable cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Placeholder method to refresh cluster membership; currently does nothing.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Simulates killing a silo; currently not implemented.
